adjudication_type: assistant visual evidence; not user/human ground truth

primary.meaning: Conservative count of definite additional visual bottle identities represented by this fixed supplied-cue recipe relative to the saved baseline; not a statistical lower confidence bound or complete physical census.

cost_accounting.duplicate_limit: Zero confirmed duplicates among credited identities does not establish zero duplicate burden in unresolved candidates.

visual_method.baseline_view_reuse: Native baseline PNGs verified byte-identical to the actual historical-baseline views already inspected in CPU gallery.
visual_method.identity_rule: Visual cap/neck/body continuity and distinct scene position; annotation IDs, IoU and renderer colors did not define identity.
visual_method.multi_object_rule: No credit for all objects merely because a box contains several. Four definite-bottle-support slots remain unresolved and get no primary credit.
visual_method.focused_independent_review: Astra coord_binding_reasoning opened all9 proposed credited crops and fullscene; no counterexample. It specifically confirmed distinct13/14 necks, closed-top cylindrical bottle16, and substantially occluded but identifiable20. Root retained final judgments.

Query-coordinate selection only is GT-coordinate-free; category and first-person history are supplied.
32 independent conditional continuations are an explicit query recipe, not one ordinary greedy trajectory.
Box accuracy, natural physical-FN reduction, preservation under training, and generalization are unmeasured.
No saved output is automatically admitted as ground truth or a training target.
